name: Rho GTPase activating protein 35
pathways: negative regulation of Rho protein signal transduction

function.text: ARHGAP35 encodes rho GTPase-activating protein 35. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and GTPase activator activity. It participates in Rho protein signal transduction and negative regulation of Rho protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Endometrial Carcinoma; Basal Cell Carcinoma; Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
